title: Electron-hosted Karma and cross-layer qualification
summary: Aligned unit and browser-driven checks with the desktop application renderer and headless execution environment.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-05-18. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Built an Electron-bound Karma workflow using dynamic loopback ports, isolated run state/logs and Playwright proofs in the same renderer/headless environment.
Added focused cross-layer vertical runners and stabilized CPU/RHEL8 execution, fixture readiness, mocking and renderer expectations.
Coordinated Electron-hosted unit tests with dynamic loopback ports, temporary run state/logs and Playwright verification in the same desktop/headless runtime.
Created focused vertical runners selecting related backend, unit, renderer-build and UI checks so feature qualification can span application layers.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
